doc: Zonal drift profile (jet minus trades minus the polar easterlies, relative to the storm track) of the default flow (hadley 30) on 721 latitudes from -90 to +90 degrees in radians, both poles and the equator included. Float64 closed form of gaussians and a smoothstep: rtol 1e-9; the value is zero at x = 1.7 (lat 51) up to rounding, which atol 1e-12 absorbs.
